blocks.text: For an Aeroplan award, I’d investigate the Hong Kong connection first: it gives the earliest Bangkok arrival among these late-departure options, with a shorter elapsed trip than the Taiwan alternatives. If arriving earlier in the day matters more, the Taiwan routing is a distinct tradeoff.

This economy award via HKG arrives 35 minutes before the later Taiwan option and has a 105-minute award connection. The downside is a stop, and its 65,000 Aeroplan points plus observed CAD 107.40 fees (quote scope unknown) do not establish an all-in price.

blocks.text: Choose this if reaching Bangkok earlier is the priority: it arrives 9 hours 10 minutes before the Hong Kong award above. It also has the longer elapsed journey, a 270-minute connection in TPE, and only one reported seat versus two on the Hong Kong option. Same program and points, but observed fees are CAD 116.50 with unknown scope.
